searchText: An article on tracking net issuance on Ethereum 2: https://www.attestant.io/posts/exploring-net-issuance/ On my list to build out an API endpoint that provides this information, which would be handy for anyone that wants to talk about total supply of Ether. nice article! an API to quickly get this information would be great i was a bit confused when i saw "issuance rate" being so high as in my experience the common usage for that term refers to the overall supply increase in the currency (usually per annum terms) possibly consider something like "realized issuance" if this terminology ends up user-facing so we don't have the confusion we are double the eth supply every year 😆

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content:
An article on tracking net issuance on Ethereum 2: https://www.attestant.io/posts/exploring-net-issuance/

On my list to build out an API endpoint that provides this information, which would be handy for anyone that wants to talk about total supply of Ether.

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: nice article! an API to quickly get this information would be great

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: i was a bit confused when i saw "issuance rate" being so high as in my experience the common usage for that term refers to the overall supply increase in the currency (usually per annum terms)

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: possibly consider something like "realized issuance" if this terminology ends up user-facing so we don't have the confusion we are double the eth supply every year 😆
